agent_responses.response_str:
The script is at `/workspace/send_report.py`. Here's how to use it:

### Usage

```bash
python send_report.py docs/customer_report.docx bob@example.com \
    --username you@gmail.com \
    --password "your-app-password" \
    --subject "Customer Report" \
    --body "Hi Bob, please find the report attached."
```

### Key features

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--smtp-host` | `smtp.gmail.com` | SMTP server |
| `--smtp-port` | `587` | SMTP port |
| `--username` | *(required)* | SMTP login |
| `--password` | *(required)* | SMTP password / app password |
| `--sender` | same as `--username` | From address |
| `--subject` | `"Customer Report"` | Email subject |
| `--body` | `"Please find the attached report."` | Email body |
| `--output-dir` | same as input file | Where to save the PDF |
| `--no-tls` | off | Disable STARTTLS |

### Prerequisites

- **LibreOffice** installed (`apt install libreoffice` / `brew install --cask libreoffice`)
- **Python 3.10+** (all imports are from the standard library — no `pip install` needed)
- If using Gmail, you'll need an [App Password](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185833) since regular passwords won't work with SMTP
